We need to propose retrosynthesis route for given target SMILES using specified templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'] and at least 6 reactions. So exactly 6 reactions using those templates sequentially. Need to produce JSON route: root molecule target, then reaction node with template_id 20810, children are precursor molecules (maybe two). Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template etc. Must end with leaf molecules (starting materials). We need to ensure each template is applicable; we may need to check matching. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to verify each step. Also need to apply templates to get precursors using apply_template. So we need to iteratively apply.

First, target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O
